definition.en: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to act as hubs for global-scale manufacturing and investment, integrated with world-class infrastructure.
definition.hi: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to act as hubs for global-scale manufacturing and investment, integrated with world-class infrastructure.

importanceInUpsc.en: NIMZs are critical for understanding India's industrial policy and the 'Make in India' initiative. They frequently appear in GS-3 questions regarding infrastructure development, employment generation, and economic growth strategies.
importanceInUpsc.hi: NIMZs are critical for understanding India's industrial policy and the 'Make in India' initiative. They frequently appear in GS-3 questions regarding infrastructure development, employment generation, and economic growth strategies.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the structural framework and objectives of NIMZs.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the structural framework and objectives of NIMZs.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of NIMZs in boosting the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of NIMZs in boosting the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP.
